hook.name: MonadLimitOrder
hook.description: A limit order hook for Uniswap v4 on Monad, wrapping OpenZeppelin's LimitOrderHook. In afterSwap, it detects crossed ticks and fills outstanding limit orders by removing liquidity and transferring tokens. Adds self-delegatecall wrappers (placeOrderNative, claimFill) to preserve msg.sender context and per-owner registration tracking.
